project_type: Greenfield Python 3 CLI package: the first bot ('Deep Research agent') of a planned multi-bot faith-content video pipeline. Produces structured research dossiers about Bible verses / teachings of Jesus Christ, built around a 'common misconception vs. deeper truth' spine.
language: Python (target >=3.10; dev/CI interpreter available is python3.12 at /usr/bin/python3.12). Default `python3` on PATH is 3.9.25 and must NOT be used for this project.
build_system: pip + venv. Pin runtime deps in requirements.txt and declare project in pyproject.toml (PEP 621). Keep deps lean: stdlib-first; allowed runtime deps limited to `requests` (HTTP) and `jsonschema` (dossier validation); dev dep `pytest`. All must be justified. The LLM SDKs (openai/anthropic) are OPTIONAL extras imported lazily so the package installs and runs dry-run with zero SDKs.
test_framework: pytest (added as a dev dependency). Tests MUST run with NO network and NO API keys, using the dry-run path + bundled fixtures. Also must pass under plain `python -m unittest` discovery where practical, but pytest is the documented runner.
build_command: python3.12 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && pip install -e . (or: pip install -r requirements.txt)
test_command: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q  (equivalently: python3.12 -m pytest -q). Tests set no API keys and must not touch the network.
verification_instructions: 1) Create venv with python3.12 and install the package (editable). 2) Run `python -m <package> research "Matthew 5:17" --dry-run` and confirm it writes BOTH a JSON dossier and a Markdown dossier to the output dir with zero network/keys. 3) Run `python -m <package> research "turn the other cheek" --dry-run` (topic path). 4) Run `python -m pytest -q` with no env keys and confirm all tests pass. 5) Validate the produced JSON dossier against the versioned schema file.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Bundled test FIXTURES (recorded API/corpus responses + a sample dossier) live under the package test fixtures dir and ARE committed. Runtime OUTPUT dossiers and the on-disk fetch CACHE are generated and git-ignored. null additional generated-source files.
setup_instructions: python3.12 -m venv .venv; . .venv/bin/activate; pip install -e '.[dev]'  (dev extra includes pytest). Copy .env.example to .env and fill OPENAI_API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY for LIVE mode; dry-run needs none.
environment_constraints: Dev/CI must be assumed to have NO outbound network and NO API keys even though this sandbox currently has PyPI + bible-api.com reachable. Therefore ALL real HTTP source fetches and ALL real LLM calls MUST sit behind interfaces that are fully stubbed in dry-run and in tests. Default `run` with no keys + no network MUST succeed from bundled fixtures/cache. Do not write tests that depend on live network or paid APIs. Confirmed working this session: python3.12, pip 23.2.1, venv, and GET https://bible-api.com/John%203:16?translation=kjv (returned KJV text).
contribution_requirements: Repo is GitHub 'Tournament' (default branch main, currently only an 11-byte README '# Tourament'). Despite the name it is unrelated to sports; it is the home of this faith-content project per explicit user instruction. Do NOT touch sibling dirs /projects/sandbox/Autosurveryai (hockey dashboard) or /projects/sandbox/Tourament (empty misspelled dup). Do NOT push or open PRs; the orchestrator publishes after return. No secrets committed; provide .env.example.
key_patterns: Two core abstractions: (1) SOURCE-CONNECTOR abstraction (a base interface + registry so new sources drop in without touching the pipeline core) with concrete connectors for Bible text (bible-api.com, public-domain KJV/WEB/ASV), original-language Strong's/lexicon data, and historical/commentary/Church-Fathers public-domain corpora (CCEL, New Advent Fathers, sacred-texts, Gutenberg). (2) LLM PROVIDER abstraction (base interface + OpenAI + Anthropic + a deterministic STUB provider used in dry-run/tests). A shared on-disk CACHE wraps HTTP so a fetched source is reused and tests can replay recorded fixtures. Graceful degradation: a failing/unavailable source records a gap in the dossier instead of crashing. Content-integrity rules enforced in prompts AND code: every substantive claim carries a source citation; uncertainty is flagged, not invented; denominational neutrality (66-book shared canon baseline, note tradition differences neutrally); NEVER scrape copyrighted modern translations (NIV/ESV).
relevant_files: /projects/sandbox/Autosurveryai/pyproject.toml (reference only: shows requires-python>=3.10, ruff/black line-length 120 conventions used in the sibling project)
directory_structure:
Planned package layout under repo root /projects/sandbox/Tournament:
  deepresearch/                      # importable package (CLI entry: python -m deepresearch)
    __init__.py, __main__.py, cli.py
    config.py                        # env + config knobs (provider, model, translations list, output/cache dirs, dry_run)
    pipeline.py                      # orchestrates the 6 stages
    models.py                        # dossier dataclasses + schema version constant
    schema/dossier.schema.json       # versioned JSON Schema contract for downstream bots
    cache.py                         # on-disk HTTP/source cache
    sources/                         # source-connector abstraction
      base.py, registry.py, bible_api.py, strongs.py, commentary.py
    llm/                             # llm provider abstraction
      base.py, openai_provider.py, anthropic_provider.py, stub_provider.py, prompts.py
    synthesis.py                     # builds dossier via llm, enforces citations/misconception->truth
    fixtures/                        # bundled sample source data for dry-run (committed)
  tests/                             # pytest suite, no network/keys
    fixtures/                        # recorded connector responses + expected sample dossier
  output/ (gitignored), .cache/ (gitignored)
